verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a structured llms.txt at developers.contasimples.com that indexes the docs, with per-section index files. The docs also state that every page is available as Markdown, either by adding .md to the URL or by sending an Accept: text/markdown header, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and no evidence of a consolidated full-content file (e.g. llms-full.txt).
